preserved_scientific_choices.model_families: Exact original Sikov FH/full-domain SAR/observed-domain SAR and graph variants; no likelihood, design, graph, bounds or sampling-variance change
preserved_scientific_choices.bootstrap_B_and_interval_estimator: unchanged per original model/job receipt: B100 primary, B300 sensitivity, original naive/BC shared draws, original delta-only graph variants
preserved_scientific_choices.RNG: Original derived seed and generator draw order, per job and endpoint; preserve common standard normal innovations after corrected central fit
preserved_scientific_choices.ICC_and_NUTS: Reuse original verified fits/draws, no new ICC sampling required by this numerical correction
preserved_scientific_choices.mixture: Proposed mixture: 75% ICC beta + 25% full-domain SAR; fixed weights, no retuning on evaluation data
preserved_scientific_choices.populations: Preserve every planned population and original context weights; no exclusions by predictive performance
preserved_scientific_choices.inference: Preserve original Holm3/Holm12 families; all revision and numerical-correction analyses identified separately

numerical_policy.rescue_rule: Deterministic same-likelihood stable residual-contrast optimization/profile for any central or bootstrap point failing projected-score certificate, including native-success cases; retain native status, original formula score, stable equivalent score, rescue steps and per-draw acceptance separately
numerical_policy.failure_rule: Never fabricate success or relax score tolerance; retain unresolved fits and fail job if fewer than original minimum accepted bootstrap draws; unresolved central fits require explicit review before promotion
numerical_policy.selection: Select solutions by fitting objective and numerical validity, never by evaluation accuracy
numerical_policy.recompute: Repeat affected bootstrap using identical seeds and original draw schedule; recalculate mixtures, summaries, MCSE, multiplicity, figures, real-data assessments and development weight sensitivity from sealed corrected predictions
